lines: Imagine government services where AI agents don't just respond.
They act, collaborate, and complete tasks for citizens.
But even a trusted agent can attempt an action it was never authorized to perform.
WAKALA verifies who the agent is, what authority it was given, and whether this specific action is permitted.
If it exceeds that authority, WAKALA stops it, before execution.
And this isn't just a concept.
Our working prototype enforces that decision through a real authorization gateway.
An authorized officer can contain the incident, restore valid authority, and let the legitimate service continue.
